tools.name: search
tools.description: Competitions, teams and players whose names hold every word of the query, each word matched at the start of a word of the name ("crystal pal"): each with its slug for the other tools, and what tells two of the same name apart.

tools.name: list_competitions
tools.description: Football competitions Footy Ferret covers, filtered by country, gender, level or part of the name: each with its slug, country, level, current season, league strength and how many matches and lineups are held.

tools.name: get_matches
tools.description: Matches on one UTC day, strongest competitions first: kickoff, state, final score, both teams’ ratings and how many lineups are in, with the day’s totals. Filter by competition or country.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: One match: kickoff, state and final score; both lineups with the time we had them and each player’s season numbers; team news; final match stats and player lines once finished; both teams’ ratings, table lines and form; earlier meetings.

tools.name: get_competition
tools.description: One competition: the official table (or ours counted from results), every team with its rating, latest results, upcoming fixtures, goal numbers and coverage.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: One team: power rating, rank and rating history, league table line, form, latest results and upcoming fixtures, the latest lineup with each player’s season numbers, squad usage and team news.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: One player: season totals per team and competition (appearances, starts, minutes, goals, assists, cards), match-by-match lines, lineups named in and squad usage.

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: Team power rankings on one rating scale, best first: rating, attack, defence, the league each team plays in, and movement over 7 days, with the biggest risers and fallers.

tools.name: get_league_strength
tools.description: Competitions ranked by league strength on one rating scale, strongest first: what an average team in each is worth, its rank, country, level and how many rated teams mainly play in it. Filter by country.

tools.name: compare_teams
tools.description: Two teams side by side: power rating, attack, defence and rank, how far apart they are and what the rating gap means against the same opponent (only within one rating scale), each team’s league and last six results, and their meetings with the tally.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
